identity.name: ProPublica
identity.description: A nonprofit investigative newsroom producing long-form accountability journalism, often in partnership with local and national news organisations.

ownership.ownershipNotes: Independent nonprofit funded by philanthropy, donations and partnerships. It does not take advertising and publishes donor information.

editorialOrientation.evidence: Nonprofit governance, published donor policies and a public investigative mission; stories frequently target powerful public and private actors.
editorialOrientation.source: Ownership and self-description via Official about page; secondary references; feed-level sample

politicalLeaning.evidence: MBFC rates ProPublica Left-Center with High factual reporting; its investigative agenda emphasises civil rights, inequality and corporate accountability.

economicPerspective.evidence: Economic coverage is accountability-driven rather than a systematic pro-market or state-directed programme.

internationalAlignment.evidence: Primarily US-focused accountability journalism with a civil-society and public-interest orientation.
internationalAlignment.source: Ownership, editorial positioning and regional coverage sample

reliability.evidence: MBFC rates factual reporting High and credibility High; ProPublica has won multiple Pulitzer Prizes and publishes methodology and corrections.

externalRatings.notes: MBFC: Left-Center; factual reporting High; credibility High (retrieved 2026-10-25).

intelligence.knownPerspective: Investigative, accountability-first journalism. It prioritises documented wrongdoing, data analysis and impact over daily news volume.

selectionRationale: Adds original investigative depth and accountability reporting that wires and general-interest publishers rarely supply.

research.researchNotes: Official About page confirmed nonprofit status and mission. Existing production taxonomy has no nonprofit source type; mapped to Commercial Publisher for compatibility. Research is feed-level only; full article sampling and peer review remain outstanding.
